title: Cardinality under symmetric difference
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. Then $|S|\leq |S\mathbin{\triangle}\{i\}|+1$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a finite subset of the coordinate set of size $n$
$i$ belongs to the coordinate set of size $n$
